judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the TDD test-writing phase and never implemented the actual production changes. `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` and `CHANGELOG.md` are completely untouched in the candidate diff, meaning the new acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately when `npm test` is run. While the candidate did update `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and wrote well-structured acceptance tests covering multi-round summation and missing-usage edge cases, none of the core logic or signature updates (`totalUsage`) were delivered. Additionally, the candidate created a separate `.acceptance.test.ts` file and left behind `.lore/dod.md`, whereas the reference added the tests directly into `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
